source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 911 adds Init to the folder-taking nsMsgMailboxParser constructor so it shares progress and lock setup with the other construction path. Context-only entry 1593 later removes the vestigial wrapper class and moves parsing/finalization responsibilities to nsParseNewMailState. The accepted class directly inherits nsParseMailMessageState and nsMsgLineBuffer. Do not revive the deleted wrapper or add its Init call to a current class by name similarity. The historical overload lesson is valid within that removed design.
title: Check the later parser hierarchy before fixing an old constructor overload
